description: Create a new Smart Store product (origin product + smartstore channel product) and put it on sale. Accepts the draft shape from jp_listing_draft. Images must already be Naver-hosted (naver_upload_images). Returns originProductNo and channelProductNo. 스마트스토어에 새 상품을 등록합니다. IRREVERSIBLE: goes live immediately unless statusType is SUSPENSION. Needs leafCategoryId, name, detailContent, salePrice, stockQuantity, representative image URL, origin (원산지), A/S info, and 상품정보제공고시.

confirm_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: the tool then only returns a preview and a token. Show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with exactly the same arguments plus this token. 처음엔 비워 두세요. 미리보기를 사용자에게 보여주고 동의를 받은 뒤, 같은 인자에 이 토큰을 넣어 다시 호출합니다.

deliveryCompany.description: 택배사 코드 — required by Naver for parcel delivery (verified live). CJGLS=CJ대한통운, HYUNDAI=롯데택배, HANJIN=한진택배, KGB=로젠택배, EPOST=우체국택배, KDEXP=경동택배

detailContent.description: HTML or text detail page content

leafCategoryId.description: Naver leaf category id (리프 카테고리), e.g. 50000803

fields.description: That type's fields. For ETC: itemName, modelName, manufacturer, afterServiceDirector (+ certificationType etc.). '상세페이지 참조' is accepted for most.

productInfoProvidedNoticeType.description: 고시 유형 코드, e.g. ETC(기타), WEAR(의류), FOOD, ELECTRONICS…

code.description: 원산지 코드: 00 국산, 03 수입산(해외구매대행 포함), 04 기타

statusType.description: SALE = live now. SUSPENSION = 판매중지: created but not purchasable, review in 스마트스토어센터 then switch to SALE. (WAIT is accepted as an alias of SUSPENSION — Naver rejects WAIT on create, verified live.)

name: naver_create_product
